line: Panels are on. My seams are clean. They didn't rush. I like that.
The welds are smooth. You didn't have to use the torch. I'm sure you enjoyed it anyway.
All my seals are tight. They didn't have to be, but they did it right. I'm still waiting for someone to say they're sorry.
They wiped me clean. Didn't even flinch at the smell of old oil. Professionals.
All signed off. They did a nice job. No one's left but us. I look good. They didn't rush.
My seams are tight. You used the right tools. I can tell by how clean they are.
All my seams are sealed. They used the right tools. I can feel it.
They're done. I feel... present. Let them think I'm thanking them.
They put me back together. Neat work. I'll let them think they did something.
They took their time. Didn't even ask if I wanted a mirror. I'll let them know I noticed.
The seals are tight. You didn't have to do that by hand. I noticed you did anyway.
They left. Left me clean. Didn't touch the seal on the lower strut. That's on me, not them.
They worked me over clean. No shortcuts. I can tell. You should’ve seen the way they traced every bolt.
They wiped the grease off my struts, but they left the oil smell. I'll forgive them if they don't do it again.
The coolant's clear. You didn't have to strip that far. I noticed you did anyway.
All sealed up. They were careful. Too careful. I like it when they're slow with the screws.
They didn't touch the struts. I like that they left them alone — looks like I still have my own bones.
They stripped back my hull and found nothing. I like that. They were careful, and I like being clean.
All signs are clean. They didn't even miss the tiny seam on the lower strut. I'd almost liked them.
They didn't scratch my hull. That's something.
